chunk_map.heading: You cannot read it all, so read where you know most

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: reader cannot tell what a pronoun points at. Closest: L4 'It is the fastest way to stop checking at page three' - 'It' resolves to 'Reading every line' in the preceding sentence of the same chunk; L6 'your interviews, your tickets, your numbers' bind to 'a source' in the same sentence.

Harm: callback to another file by position dies when deck order shifts. Closest: L6 'Each of you owns a source' - a present-tense setup in this slide, no pointer to another slide or file. grep for 'opening|earlier|last|previous|above|before' in body_numbered: only L4 'left alone', none a callback.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: stranded 'the X you did' reference. Closest: L6 'the line from your own material you would trust least' - an instruction, not a recap of a beat done. No 'you did/saw/caught' construction in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no demo or guess-before-reveal beat; every sentence is verbed

rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: slide says nothing standalone. L4 'Reading every line is not control' is a self-carrying claim, L6 and L8 add a move each.

Harm: header contradicted by content. L1 'You cannot read it all, so read where you know most' is followed by L4 (cannot read it all) and L6 (read where you know the most); closest drift: L8 'Ask for the shape you can use' adds a third move the header does not name, but does not contradict it.

Harm: tics visible at slide density. Sub-items: not-X-not-Y-Z: L4 has a single 'not' pair 'is not control. It is the fastest way' - two sentences, no third leg; anaphora triple: L6 'your interviews, your tickets, your numbers' is a concrete list of three distinct sources, not an empty third leg; self-grading superlative: none ('fastest way to stop checking' is a claim about the failure, not about the training); number+retraction: none; abstraction stack: none; empty-verb triplet: none.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: repo vocabulary projected on a wall. Closest: L8 'the shape you can use' - plain English. No surface/firing/compendium/forcing function/beat/mood in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: single-slide file under curriculum/slides/ with a ## heading and slide marker; renders as its own deck slide, no phase-less prose section

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/slides/you-cannot-read-it-all.md -> 'OK - 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent.' exit 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/you-cannot-read-it-all.md -> 'OK - 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.' exit 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no links in body (grep for '](' returns none); rule states no editorial standard

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 '## You cannot read it all, so read where you know most' is a claim-plus-imperative header, fitting lecture register (claims) and the law/consolidation beat it carries.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: content redundancy that reads as rigour. Per paragraph: L4 gives the problem, L6 the move (own source, distrust one line, say why), L8 the output shape. Closest to (c) kicker: L4 'the fastest way to stop checking at page three' - concrete failure mode, not a koan restating the header. No doctrine restatement (a), no pedagogy commentary (b).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no evidence of a header rename; maintainer block records a round-3 rewrite, not a retitle over inherited bullets

notes: One-slide file; chunk 0 is the only chunk. Accept-note found: L12 STATUS round 3 fixes (2026-10-06), not touching any rule. Class brief built normally (17 rules, none prefilled).
